newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta share index hits new high.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta share index hits new high.

text.p: Jakarta share index rose to new highs in mid-afternoon trading on Tuesday on continued investor buying of blue chips such as Telkom, Bank Negara Indonesia and Sampoerna, brokers said.
The index hit 732.39 and within minutes moved up to 732.52 points, after closing at a record 724.56 on Monday.
"Buying interest from local and foreign investors is very strong," the head of sales with a large local brokerage said. "Counters said to be planning corporate action were among the favourites."
He referred to Eterindo Wahana and Intikeramik Alam, which had been actively traded on market talk of a possible private placement.
He also said the sharp rebound in blue chip Sampoerna helped the index to edge up and boost sentiment on firstliners.

"I always look at the fundamentals of the Indonesia economy. It is among the strongest in the Asian region and many fund managers are favourable about Indonesia," Motoo Murata, senior analyst at Daiwa Research Institute in Jakarta said.
He said price earnings of some blue chips were still below 20 times 1997 projected earnings.
"Telkom, Bank Negara Indonesia and Sampoerna are still considered cheap stocks," he said.
